source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current malformed-input factory formats the localized error, then adds a bad-value suffix in automation. The test helper resolves the expected Fluent text before invoking Assert.throws and checks Error.isError plus message.startsWith. A complete-message equality check would include the diagnostic suffix; checking only that something throws would lose the intended error. The original commit adds the corresponding email-address properties key, and its owned factory loads the key before constructing the exception. Its Fluent review proposal was deferred; the fixed Fluent factory and async test helper are later accepted code, not adoption inferred from a review status. The test does not require the private MalformedException subclass specifically. No localization or test execution was performed.
title: Sanitizer error tests compare the localized message prefix
